item.tib: bdud rtsi a ma ra ya las phum bum dgu pa'i sgrub gzhung
item.coloph: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i sgrab pa 'di ni/ dang po yum sras gshen gsum la rim par brgyud nas/ dar nub kyi cho 'phrul la/ snang ru brag gnam skas can la gter du sbas so/ phyis dus su khu 'dzu srid pa'i rgyal po de nyid kyis gter zhal phyes nas/ shAkya dpal gyi dngos grub du bab pa ste/ gshen dam pa rgyal tshab chen pos mnga' bsnyems pa'o/ des rim par brgyud do/ tha tshan mu tsug smar ro//
